species.name: Human
species.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most widespread people in the world, quickly adapting to any environment or culture.

subspecies.name: High Elf
subspecies.description: Refined and learned, high elves blend elven grace with a natural aptitude for arcane magic.

subspecies.name: Wood Elf
subspecies.description: Reclusive forest-dwellers with preternatural swiftness and keen senses, deeply at home in the wild.

subspecies.name: Drow
subspecies.description: Exiled to the Underdark, drow wield innate shadow magic and extraordinary darkvision, often working to overcome a dark reputation.

subspecies.name: Hill Dwarf
subspecies.description: Perceptive and resilient, hill dwarves live among rolling highlands and are renowned for extraordinary toughness.

subspecies.name: Mountain Dwarf
subspecies.description: Born in high peaks, mountain dwarves are powerfully built warriors at home in heavy armor.

subspecies.name: Lightfoot
subspecies.description: Nimble and sociable, lightfoot halflings blend into almost any community with natural charm and quiet luck.

subspecies.name: Stout
subspecies.description: Sturdier than their kin, stout halflings carry a touch of dwarven blood that grants resistance to poison.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Proud dragon-descended warriors who breathe elemental energy shaped by their draconic lineage.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Bearing infernal heritage in their horns and tails, tieflings wield innate dark magic and an iron will forged against prejudice.

subspecies.name: Forest Gnome
subspecies.description: Nature-attuned tinkerers who speak with small animals and conjure minor illusions as easily as breathing.

subspecies.name: Rock Gnome
subspecies.description: Inventive artificers with an insatiable passion for clockwork gadgets and mechanical contraptions.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Mountain-born giants driven by a fierce competitive spirit and an unwavering need to prove their worth.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Powerful warriors whose orcish endurance lets them shrug off blows that would fell lesser combatants.

species.name: Aasimar
species.description: Touched by celestial radiance, aasimar carry divine light within them, drawn by destiny toward heroic deeds.
